projects.title: Flyin' High
projects.description:
Stuttgart Airways is a new charter airline, offering passengers flight connections from beach holidays, to hot water destinations, and short city trips. 

We were asked to create a simple, catchy logo that would appear in a wide range of their corporate materials, digital platforms and branded airplanes.

The Website

We worked closely with Stuttgart Airways to redesign and develop their website, implementing UX, design and development in-house, adapted for a fast and smooth browsing experience, seamless on various devices.
